goal_summary: Build and verify the complete bilingual Unit 1 study PWA without publishing copyrighted source material or live AI credentials.
acceptance_criteria: Search, study, review, persistence, backup, PPC and PWA workflows pass
Worker contract is secure and mock-tested
Source PDF and secrets are untracked

tasks.title: Lock mission and establish independent repository safety
Scaffold application, legal files and development toolchain
tasks.notes: Dependencies installed; Node-compatible jsdom pinned; typecheck passed.

tasks.title: Define content contracts, manifest and validation pipeline
acceptance: Schemas cover localized content and quiz types
Validator fails invalid references and wrong count
tasks.notes: 43-entry manifest, localized Markdown contract, quiz contract, strict/draft validator and compiler verified.

tasks.title: Build the first meaningful study-workspace preview
acceptance: Three-column workspace renders representative bilingual content
Search entry and primary navigation are visible
tasks.notes: Three-column bilingual workspace compiled, returned HTTP 200, and was handed off in the Codex browser.

tasks.title: Author and validate Unit 1.1 bilingual content
acceptance: 15 planned 1.1 points contain full bilingual study fields and quizzes
tasks.notes: All 15 Unit 1.1 points now compile with bilingual study fields, sourced examples, flashcards and MCQs.

tasks.title: Author and validate Unit 1.2 bilingual content
acceptance: 8 planned 1.2 points contain full bilingual study fields and quizzes
tasks.notes: All eight Unit 1.2 points compile with bilingual content and two practice items each.

tasks.title: Author and validate Unit 1.3 bilingual content
acceptance: 6 planned 1.3 points contain full bilingual study fields and quizzes
tasks.notes: All six Unit 1.3 model and PPC points compile with bilingual content and practice.

tasks.title: Author and validate Unit 1.4 bilingual content
acceptance: 6 planned 1.4 points contain full bilingual study fields and quizzes
tasks.notes: All six Unit 1.4 methodology points compile with bilingual content and practice.

tasks.title: Author and validate Unit 1.5 bilingual content
acceptance: 8 planned 1.5 points complete the exact 43-point manifest
tasks.notes: All eight Unit 1.5 extension points compile; strict validation now passes exactly 43 bilingual points. The closely related Keynesian revolution and formation of macro policy remain one atomic card.

tasks.title: Complete dual navigation, bilingual search and temporary scope
acceptance: Bilingual fuzzy search and filters work
tasks.notes: Hash-routed study/search views, 43-point dual directories, weighted bilingual fuzzy search, level filters and session-only section scopes pass 10 focused tests.

tasks.title: Implement progress persistence and versioned backup restore
tasks.notes: IndexedDB persistence, progress/settings views, atomic merge/replace import, schema validation and sensitive-data exclusions pass five focused tests.

tasks.title: Implement review modes, answer scoring and scheduling
acceptance: Keyword coverage and override are visible
tasks.notes: All 43 points now have flashcard, MCQ and short-answer items. Bilingual keyword scoring, manual override, four modes and deterministic FSRS mastery/rollback pass seven tests.

tasks.title: Implement accessible interactive PPC and responsive layouts
tasks.notes: Interactive PPC supports pointer, keyboard, sliders, frontier snapping, growth shifts and reset, with static SVG/table alternatives; four model tests pass. Responsive browser evidence is deferred to T017.

tasks.title: Add PWA offline/update behavior
acceptance: App shell/content work after offline reload
tasks.notes: Prompt-update PWA precaches ten shell/content assets. Generated manifest/SW audit confirms no IndexedDB deletion, credential material or AI runtime caching. Offline browser reload remains for T017.

tasks.title: Add unconfigured AI UI and secure Worker contract
acceptance: No credential is created or embedded
Owner auth, CORS, limits and citation validation are tested
tasks.notes: Live model behavior remains NOT CONFIGURED. Eight Worker and four client contract tests pass; local token storage is excluded from backup; secret scan passed across 251 candidate files.

tasks.title: Finish open-source docs and GitHub automation
acceptance: README, contribution rules, notices, CI and Pages workflow are complete
tasks.notes: Bilingual README and contributor/security/privacy/publishing/Worker docs, PR/Dependabot configuration, CI/Pages workflows, deterministic content/copyright reports and repository validation pass the full verification gate.

tasks.title: Run full verification, visual QA and acceptance reporting
acceptance: Final report maps evidence and limitations
tasks.notes: Full verify, 10 applicable Playwright checks across three viewports, manual headed-browser inspection, copyright audit, and both verify plus Playwright from a fresh local clone pass. Visual QA found and fixed a PPC icon selector regression.

tasks.title: Add the check-only ESLint release gate
acceptance: Flat ESLint configuration covers authored source and tests
The full verify command includes lint
tasks.notes: The final plan audit found and closed a missing lint gate. ESLint 10 with TypeScript and React rules now passes check-only; findings led to purity and unused-import cleanups.

blockers: GitHub CLI authentication for louisjia2008-ux is invalid; no remote repository, branch push, PR, hosted CI, or Pages deployment can be truthfully verified until the user re-authenticates and authorises that external publication step.
